info.name: Large File Previews
info.summary: Previews of PDF and Illustrator files too large for Nextcloud's own preview providers
info.description:
Renders previews of files too large for Nextcloud's own preview providers, by running a command-line renderer on the file's local path rather than loading the file into PHP or sending it to a service.
What you get:
- **PDF and Illustrator previews** through `pdftoppm` (poppler), of the first page, at the full preview size, for files of any size. - **Limits around every render**: a timeout, a memory cap and a raised out-of-memory score, each switchable and each with its value. - **Per type and per extension**: which files the app takes, and from which size up to which size; anything it declines goes to the next provider.
Only files on local, unencrypted storage are rendered. Everything else is left to Nextcloud's other preview providers.
info.author: metaworx resonare rüegg
